headline: Bitstamp Outflow Widens To 301.4 Million Dollars From 140.9 Million As Binance Intake Rises To 862.7 Million
narrative: Bitstamp's clean-asset outflow widened to 301.4 million dollars from 140.9 million, so more dollar value left that venue than on the prior reading. Binance intake rose to 862.7 million dollars from 772.3 million, which means the largest arrival pipe took in more clean-asset value while Bitstamp sent more out. The pipe sums the 24-hour change in dollars held on 79 venues excluding each exchange's own token, and that complex is a 975.7 million dollar inflow, 0.3605 percent of the 270.6 billion dollars held there.
author: jordan
